content: sharp composite(images) accepts an array of {input, gravity, top, left, blend}; gravity:'centre' auto-centers an overlay image without manual top/left math — the standard pattern for a centered logo overlay on a QR PNG. Overlay images must be <= the base image dimensions. sharp also accepts SVG buffers as direct input (image read), rasterizing via its bundled SVG loader without needing a system librsvg install.
